APPROVE. The extracted `WholeArrayArgumentBounds` keeps the same checks in the same order with the same null returns, and the caller still gets `open` and `close` for the loop, so behaviour is unchanged. Moving the four top-level `if`s out (plus the `||` and `&&`) and adding one `is null` check should bring the complexity from 16 to about 11, and nothing in the diff should break the build.

I could only see the diff, not the unshown lines between the hunks, so I assumed they don't use `at` or `after`.
